meta.tool: Skyfield 1.53 with JPL DE421 (development only, not shipped)
meta.conventions: Sunrise/sunset: upper limb, standard refraction (centre at -0.8333 deg), sea level. Tithi/karana from apparent Moon - Sun; nakshatra/yoga sidereal with mean Lahiri. Indexes: tithi 0-29, karana 0-59 (half-tithis), nakshatra 0-26, yoga 0-26. Element in force at sunrise; "ends" is its first change after sunrise. Times are UTC.
